# Labels

WhyViral ships with a small, opinionated label set. Apply these to every
new issue / PR so triage is one-click.

## Issue labels

| Label | Color | When to apply |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bug` | `#d73a4a` | Something is broken |
| `enhancement` | `#a2eeef` | A new feature or improvement |
| `docs` | `#0075ca` | Documentation only |
| `question` | `#d876e3` | User needs help |
| `triage` | `#ededed` | Needs a maintainer look |
| `pinned` | `#fbca04` | Won't be auto-closed by `stale.yml` |
| `security` | `#b60205` | Security-sensitive change |
| `in-progress` | `#0e8a16` | Actively being worked on |
| `good first issue` | `#7057ff` | Small, well-scoped, friendly to new contributors |
| `help wanted` | `#008672` | Maintainer would love a PR |
| `duplicate` | `#cfd3d7` | Already filed |
| `wontfix` | `#ffffff` | Out of scope / by design |

## PR labels

| Label | Color | When to apply |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `deps` | `#0366d6` | Dependabot npm update |
| `ci` | `#1d76db` | Dependabot GitHub Actions update |
